main_chase_cards.name: Pryce's Lapras
main_chase_cards.why: Pryce's Lapras is the Information Pack route turning toward the VS era. It is not only Lapras, and not only Pryce; it is a gym-owner card first handed out through a free information volume, then echoed in Japanese VS with a 1st Edition mark. That stamp boundary is the whole collector hinge.

key_artists.name: Mitsuhiro Arita
key_artists.why: Arita's importance is not just volume. He helped form the earliest visual grammar of the TCG, from prototype-era card art to iconic Base Set images. On Pryce's Lapras, that grounded, everyday-Pokemon sensibility turns a gym-owner promo into a believable cold-water companion.

claims.text: The local catalog and Bulbapedia align on July 19, 2001 for Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3 Pryce's Lapras distribution.

Bulbapedia states Pryce's Lapras was first available as an unnumbered promotional card in the third volume of Pokemon Card Information, distributed for free at participating stores from July 19, 2001.
The local release family models one row: Pryce's Lapras source index 237, with the promotion note Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3 insert.
Bulbapedia's 2001 unnumbered-promo table places Pryce's Lapras after Vol. 2 Bellossom and before Vol. 4 Ponyta, making it the third step of the Information Pack sequence modeled in this queue.
Bulbapedia states Pryce's Lapras was later reprinted in the Japanese Pokemon VS expansion and that the only discernible difference between the two prints is the presence of a 1st Edition symbol.

Bulbapedia identifies Mitsuhiro Arita / 有田満弘 as a TCG illustrator since the beginning of the Pokemon TCG, connected to early prototype work, Base Set Pikachu and Charizard, and early Energy-symbol design.

Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3 matters because it is a hinge between free Information Pack distribution and Japanese VS set identity: the same Pryce's Lapras family can be promo or VS depending on the 1st Edition-symbol boundary.
This release dossier carries a special identification packet for Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3 Pryce's Lapras source index 237.

narrative.human_title: Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3 — Pryce's Lapras at the VS threshold
narrative.why_it_matters: Vol. 3 is where the Information Pack route starts touching a bigger set story. Pryce's Lapras is a free shop-counter promo first, then a Japanese VS card family distinguished by the tiny but crucial 1st Edition-symbol boundary. It is exactly the kind of object this catalog was built for: a quiet route detail that changes what the card is.

special_identification_instructions.summary: Treat this route as Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3 Pryce's Lapras source index 237, distributed through the third information volume, not as a generic Lapras or the 1st Edition Japanese VS print.
special_identification_instructions.trigger: A listing, want, scan, seller note, or agent memory says Pryce's Lapras, ヤナギのラプラス, Yanagi no Laplace, Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3, ポケモンカードインフォメーション その3, Information Pack, VS 041/141, Mitsuhiro Arita, Sing, Tsunami, or source index 237.
steps: Anchor the route to Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3 / ポケモンカードインフォメーション その3 and July 19, 2001.
Confirm the candidate is Pryce's Lapras / ヤナギのラプラス / Yanagi no Laplace, not a generic Lapras.
Use source index 237 as the local catalog audit handle.
Preserve the distribution route: third volume of Pokemon Card Information, free at participating stores.
Check the 1st Edition-symbol boundary carefully: the Information Pack promo lacks the 1st Edition symbol; the Japanese VS expansion reprint carries it.
Use Mitsuhiro Arita / 有田満弘 as the expected illustrator credit.
Separate this release from Pokemon Card Information Vol. 1 Dunsparce, Vol. 2 Bellossom, Vol. 4 Ponyta, Japanese VS 1st Edition Pryce's Lapras, and generic Lapras listings.
If a seller claims an unopened information packet, ask for packet-front, packet-back, insert visibility, and card-closeup evidence because packet route and card state are separate claims.
Before any funded trade, require seller-controlled evidence for the exact physical card or sealed packet being claimed.

claims.text: The local catalog anchors Pryce's Lapras as source index 237 in the Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3 unnumbered-promo source row.
Bulbapedia identifies the card as Pryce's Lapras / ヤナギのラプラス, a Water-type Basic Pokemon card with HP 60, LV.31, and later Japanese VS number 041/141.
Bulbapedia and Serebii list Sing / うたう and Tsunami / つなみ as the card's attacks, with Metal weakness and one retreat cost.
Bulbapedia identifies Mitsuhiro Arita / 有田満弘 as the illustrator for Pryce's Lapras.
Bulbapedia states the Information Pack promo was later reprinted in Japanese Pokemon VS and that the only discernible difference is the presence of a 1st Edition symbol.
Arita has provided TCG artwork since the TCG's beginning, contributed from prototype stages, and is tied to early Base Set Pikachu and Charizard as career-defining images.
Pryce's Lapras matters because it turns a tiny mark into a real identity wall: no 1st Edition symbol points toward the Information Pack promo route, while the stamped print points toward Japanese VS.
This card dossier carries a special identification packet for Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3 Pryce's Lapras source index 237.

narrative.human_title: Pryce's Lapras — source index 237, the unstamped VS threshold
narrative.why_it_matters: Pryce's Lapras is gentle but exacting. It has Arita's old-TCG hand, Pryce's cold Johto identity, and Lapras's quiet transport myth, but the collector hinge is almost comically small: the 1st Edition symbol. Without it, the card points back to Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3; with it, the same family becomes Japanese VS. That is the kind of tiny material fact agents need to love.

special_identification_instructions.summary: Treat this as Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3 Pryce's Lapras only when trainer-owned Lapras identity, source index 237, Information Pack route, Arita credit, and absent 1st Edition symbol line up.
special_identification_instructions.trigger: A listing, scan, want, seller note, or agent memory says Pryce's Lapras, ヤナギのラプラス, Yanagi no Laplace, Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3, Information Pack, VS 041/141, 1st Edition symbol, Mitsuhiro Arita, LV.31, HP 60, Sing, Tsunami, or source index 237.
steps: Confirm the card is Pryce's Lapras / ヤナギのラプラス / Yanagi no Laplace, LV.31, Water type, Basic, HP 60.
Confirm the Pokemon Card Information Vol. 3 / Information Pack route and source index 237 in this local unnumbered-promo catalog.
Check the 1st Edition-symbol boundary: absent symbol supports the Information Pack promo route; present symbol supports the Japanese VS expansion reprint.
Use Mitsuhiro Arita / 有田満弘 as the expected illustrator.
Use Sing / うたう and Tsunami / つなみ as row-detail clues.
Use Metal weakness and one retreat cost as secondary text-layout checks when seller photos are sharp.
Separate this row from Japanese VS 1st Edition Pryce's Lapras 041/141, generic Lapras cards, other Pryce/Yanagi cards, and Pokemon Card Information Vol. 1, Vol. 2, or Vol. 4 promos.
